findings.claim: Every call to `create_run` in the entire test suite (and in production callers `cell/session.py` and `replay.py`) omits `batch_id`, so no test ever exercises the parameter actually being written and round-tripped for a non-None value. Replacing the bound tuple `(repo_id, base_sha, batch_id)` with `(repo_id, base_sha, None)` — silently discarding whatever the caller passes — keeps all 1248 tests green, including the new `test_a_run_created_outside_a_batch_has_a_null_batch_id`, because that test only checks the default-None path. The gap is invisible today since nothing calls `create_run` with a real `batch_id` yet, but it means the plumbing this spec adds for `SA-0049` to use is unverified for the one case it exists to serve.
